title: Foundations
intro: Tokens, type, locale and motion: the base every screen is built on. Switch theme, direction, language, digits and currency to see each rule hold.

sweep.title: The sweep
sweep.description: One hue per context, from me to company. Volt marks only what is happening now.
sweep.voltUsage: Live block, now-dot, active task. One volt element per view.

context.title: Context colours
context.description: The active context drives the primary colour. Text on an accent always uses on-accent.

neutrals.title: Neutrals
neutrals.description: Graphite, never black. In dark, surfaces step up in lightness instead of casting shadows.

status.title: Status
status.description: Status pairs colour with an icon and a label, never colour alone.

dataviz.title: Deep card & data colours
dataviz.description: Tokens only: the deep signature card (graphite-mint in dark) and the frozen DataViz palette. Chart components arrive with the first screen that uses them.
dataviz.deepCardTitle: Your best focus is 09–12 on Sat–Mon.

surfaces.title: Surfaces & depth
surfaces.description: Canvas → surface → raised → subtle. Islands float with a soft shadow in light and a lighter surface in dark.

borders.title: Borders
borders.description: Three steps, from dividers to outline controls.

radii.title: Radii & notch
radii.description: Signature cards 32, product cards 28, utility cards 20, fields 16; controls are capsules. The notch geometry follows P00 and mirrors in RTL.

shadows.title: Shadows
shadows.description: Only islands and overlays cast shadows. Focus is a ring, not a shadow.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Urbanist for Latin, Vazirmatn for Persian. Persian gets taller lines and no tracking, caps or italics.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: Named steps on a 4px grid. 48px is the minimum touch target.

icons.title: Icons · mirror or keep
icons.description: Direction-bearing icons flip in RTL; objects, symbols and axes never do. Switch direction to check.

focus.title: Focus states
focus.description: Tab through these controls. The ring is a 3px halo with an edge so it reads on any surface.

dates.title: Calendar & dates
dates.description: Jalali by default, Gregorian on request. The week starts Saturday; Saturday–Wednesday are work days, Thursday is a half day, Friday is the weekend.

numbers.title: Digits & money
numbers.description: Digits follow the user's setting, not the language. Money is stored in Toman; Rial = Toman × 10.

bdi.title: Mixed text
bdi.description: Wrap Latin names, times and codes inside Persian sentences in {tag} so punctuation stays put.

motion.title: Motion tokens
motion.description: Durations, easings and springs shared by CSS and Motion. Everything collapses to instant under reduced motion.
motion.reducedOn: Reduced motion is on: transitions are instant.

componentsPage.title: Components
componentsPage.intro: Every base component in every state, built from the tokens on the Foundations page. Change the preview settings to check light and dark, both directions, both languages and both digit sets.
componentsPage.scopeHint: The primary colour follows the active context. Utility boards show Projects blue.

fields.title: Text fields
fields.description: 48px inputs with a 1.5px outline. Focus is a ring plus the scope colour, never colour alone.

select.title: Select & multi-select
select.description: A listbox with colour dots that always sit next to a label, toggle chips for many values, and the search capsule.
select.searchHint: Press ⌘K or Ctrl+K to focus it. Escape clears the text.

controls.title: Controls
controls.description: Switches for settings that apply at once, checkboxes for choices in a list, segmented for views, a range for amounts.

choices.title: Radio group
choices.description: One choice from a short list. Each option can carry a second line.

datePicker.title: Date picker
datePicker.description: Starts in your calendar setting; switch between Jalali and Gregorian. Saturday starts the week and Friday is the weekend.
datePicker.bare: Calendar on its own: neighbouring days shown, only the next three weeks selectable.

toasts.title: Toasts & alerts
toasts.description: Toasts confirm what just happened and can offer Undo. Inline alerts stay with the content they describe.

info.title: Synced with Google Calendar
info.description: Your events are up to date.

warning.title: Over capacity
warning.description: Today has 9h planned for 8h of capacity.

danger.title: Couldn’t save expense
danger.description: You’re offline. We’ll retry when you reconnect.

neutral.title: Draft saved
neutral.description: You can pick it up later.

toasts.undoAlt: Reopen the task from the task list.
toasts.tooltipText: Energy = how demanding a block is

buttons.title: Button states
buttons.description: Primary takes the active context’s deep colour, one primary per view. Hover, pressed and focus are static previews.

states.title: Loading · empty · error
states.description: Skeletons mirror the real layout. Empty states suggest a next step; errors offer a retry.
states.loadingCaption: The shimmer stops when reduced motion is on.
states.emptyDescription: Pull something from Unscheduled or enjoy the evening.
states.comingSoon: Unscheduled arrives in a later step.
states.errorRetried: {count, plural, one {Retried {formatted} time. Still a sample.} other {Retried {formatted} times. Still a sample.}}

indicators.title: More states
indicators.description: No results, not yet available, skeleton anatomy and spinners.
indicators.spinnerHint: Labelled when it stands alone; decorative inside a busy control.

overlays.title: Dialogs & sheets
overlays.description: Focus moves in and returns to the trigger; Escape closes. On desktop each container follows the P18 rule; on mobile every one of them becomes a bottom sheet.
overlays.dialogDescription: A short task that needs the user’s attention.
overlays.dialogBody: The new name shows on the schedule and in reminders.
overlays.confirmDescription: Confirm stays busy until the async action settles.
overlays.confirmBody: 6 subtasks and 7 comments go with it. You can undo for 10 seconds.
overlays.tooltipDescription: White in light, graphite in dark, with a hairline ring and a soft shadow; never an ink fill. Hover or focus the button.
overlays.tooltipText: Energy = how demanding a block is
overlays.drawerRule: Multi-field create and edit (Habit, Goal), from the inline end.
overlays.drawerBody: Illustrative fields only; the real flow comes later.
overlays.detailRule: One object’s detail over the current page (Task detail), with a 28% scrim.
overlays.detailBody: Illustrative content in a scrolling body with a pinned footer.
overlays.bottomSheetDescription: The mobile container for everything above: grab handle, rounded top, safe area.
overlays.quickAddBody: What would you like to add?
overlays.floatingRule: Quick note and Voice. Non-modal on desktop: no scrim, the page stays usable.
overlays.popoverRule: One-decision flows (Mood, Reschedule) use a popover; see Menus & popovers.
overlays.geometryRule: Panels are product surfaces: 32px radius, no notch.
overlays.mobileRule: Mobile: all of them become bottom sheets.

form.title: Form validation
form.description: React Hook Form with a Zod schema. Errors appear after submit, link from the summary to each field, and clear as you fix them.

errors.title: Enter a title of at least 3 characters.
errors.amount: Enter a number greater than zero.

menus.title: Menus & popovers
menus.description: Menus hold actions and options; arrow keys move, typing jumps. Popovers hold short, non-modal content.
menus.deleteSample: Delete is a sample action here.
menus.energyBody: How demanding a block is: low, medium or high. Planning mixes them so the day stays doable.

dataDisplay.title: Badges, avatars & dividers
dataDisplay.description: Counts and dots carry a spoken label. Avatars show initials on a scope tint when there is no photo.
dataDisplay.unread: {count, plural, one {{formatted} unread notification} other {{formatted} unread notifications}}

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: The default progress patterns: linear, segmented, numeric and compact inline. Rings are not a default (see Rules).

linear.title: Linear
linear.label: Subtasks
linear.source: S3 subtasks · S1 and S4 tiles · S10 budgets

segmented.title: Segmented
segmented.source: Shell hero bar · Main · Cards lead dashes · S1 habits · S4 milestones

numeric.title: Numeric
numeric.source: Cards folder tab · S6 tiles · S11 key results

inline.title: Compact inline
inline.source: Task card footers (Dashboard, S4, MobileTasks) · S2 capacity

progress.specializedNote: Circular rings are a specialized visualization. Use one only where a screen design draws it: the RingCard focus summary, goal progress (S1, S11), project health (S4), company health (S6) or habit completion (S9).

tabs.title: Tab families
tabs.description: Four tab families, each with one job. Pick one with the selection rule; global destinations are navigation, never tabs.

pills.title: B · Compact pill tabs
pills.use: a local filter or secondary mode
pills.label: Task filter
pills.mobileNote: From 1024px the active pill is white with an ink outline; on mobile it takes the soft scope tint (mint in Personal).

filled.title: C · Filled pill tabs
filled.use: an active mode that needs emphasis
filled.label: Focus mode

folder.title: D · Folder tabs
folder.body: The active tab merges into its card. Top tabs for an object’s sections, bottom tabs for 2–3 views of a compact object.
folder.link: See Folder tabs and Ring card

rule.title: Selection rule
rule.object: Sections of one object → Folder tabs
rule.global: Global destination → Navigation (rail or bottom nav), never tabs

avoid.title: Do not use folder tabs for

cards.title: Signature cards
cards.description: Card geometry A (P00): a standalone, important object with a sculpted top inline-end corner that holds ONE circular primary action or stays empty. Shown on the canvas so the cut-out is visible; in RTL it moves to the top-left.
cards.actionCaption: A · Action in notch: one primary action, the only volt area on this page
cards.emptyCaption: A · Empty notch: negative space as identity
cards.navigationCaption: A · Navigation action: a neutral circle

insight.label: Insight
insight.body: Your best focus is {from}–{to} on Sat–Mon.

presets.title: Notch presets
presets.auto: The default preset is auto: the mobile notch below {breakpoint}px and the desktop notch from {breakpoint}px, switched in CSS before any script runs. In RTL the notch moves to the top-left by itself.

uses.focus: Focus timer card (P09): the notch holds Pause

presets.label: {name} preset

rules.title: Signature rules
rules.oneAction: Exactly one action, always circular, always the card’s primary. Secondary actions live inside the card.
rules.emptyNotch: Leave the notch empty on one card per view when it creates hierarchy (Insight, Weekly Story, Goal summary).
rules.density: At most 3 signature cards per desktop viewport and 1–2 on mobile. Only one may be volt.
rules.never: Never notch rows, list items, board cards, form sections, filter panels, settings groups, KPI tiles, toasts or sheets.

productCard.title: Product card
productCard.description: Card geometry B: the standard surface for repeated or moderately dense content. A soft 28px rectangle with 20px padding, optional scope tint, never a notch.
productCard.caption: Soft rounded rectangle · no notch · may be scope-tinted

utilityCard.title: Utility card
utilityCard.description: Card geometry C: filters, form groups, settings groups and empty-state boxes. 20px radius, subtle or white, no shadow, no decoration, never a notch.
utilityCard.caption: Quiet, compact, simple geometry
utilityCard.label: View options

metricTiles.title: Metric tiles
metricTiles.description: A related family shares one clean geometry: subtle tiles with a 20px radius and no notch on any item. The group reflows by its own width: four across, or 2 × 2.
metricTiles.caption: Related family · one geometry, no individual notches
metricTiles.label: This week

folderTabs.title: Folder tabs
folderTabs.description: D · Sections of ONE object. The active tab is 56px tall with a 24px top radius and joins the panel through two 20px concave fillets; inactive tabs are 44px outlined capsules with a muted count, never a coloured badge. Below 1024px the row becomes compact pills.
folderTabs.label: Goal sections
folderTabs.tasksBody: The goal’s {count} open tasks would be listed here.
folderTabs.filesBody: The goal’s {count} files would be listed here.
folderTabs.activityEmpty: No activity to show in the styleguide.

ringCard.title: Ring card
ringCard.description: D′ · The same folder geometry flipped below the card: equal-width uppercase tabs for 2–3 views of one compact object. Rings are reserved for Today progress and this habit card.
ringCard.subtitle: Completion · {month}

navigationPage.title: Navigation & shell
navigationPage.intro: The rail, context switcher, mobile bar and top-bar islands, previewed in frames so nothing is pinned to this page. The live shell puts them together.
navigationPage.scopeHint: Pick a context to retint every preview and swap its navigation.

rail.title: Floating rail
rail.description: Icon-only and expandable. Planned pages are disabled with “Coming soon”. It sits on the right in RTL.
rail.groupedNote: Hidden modules leave the rail; a group that empties takes its separator with it.

switcher.title: Context switcher
switcher.description: The top-bar pill and its panel, shown open. Choosing a workspace switches the preview context.
switcher.caption: Trigger and panel with sample workspaces

mobile.title: Mobile navigation
mobile.description: Context chips scroll inside themselves; the bottom bar has a notched quick-add button and opens all pages from More.
mobile.caption: Phone frame · 390px

pageHeader.title: Breadcrumbs & page header
pageHeader.description: Ancestors truncate first on narrow widths; separators mirror in RTL. The header keeps its action at the inline end.

navList.title: Context page list
navList.description: Every page of the context, used by the More sheet and the command palette.
navList.caption: Pages of the preview context

schedule.title: Schedule island
schedule.description: The current block lifts in white with its elapsed share filled; the volt dot marks now. Narrow tracks drop upcoming blocks.

topBar.title: Top bar
topBar.description: The real shell islands with sample data: home, context switcher, schedule and actions (search ⌘K, quick create, notifications, account). As in the app outside a context, they show Personal; choosing a workspace opens its context.
topBar.caption: Desktop top bar · scrolls inside the frame on small screens
topBar.assistantCaption: Assistant button (fixed at the bottom inline end in the app)

liveShell.title: Live application shell
liveShell.description: See every part working together, with real routes, at full size.

foundations.title: Styleguide
foundations.description: Mehran Planner foundations: tokens, themes, RTL, locale formatting and motion.

components.title: Components · Styleguide
components.description: Mehran Planner base components: fields, controls, buttons, overlays, feedback and surfaces in every state.

navigation.title: Navigation & shell · Styleguide
navigation.description: Mehran Planner navigation and shell parts: rail, context switcher, mobile bar, breadcrumbs and top bar.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Mehran Planner design-system tiers, component classification and pattern rules, with board evidence.

utility.name: Utility
utility.description: Flat, compact, dense. Forms, tables, filters.
utility.where: Settings, forms, tables, filters, task lists, activity feeds, approvals and expense rows. Never notched.

product.name: Product
product.description: Plain sculpted card, scope tint as cue.
product.where: Content cards: tag row → title → meta → footer. The primary action sits at the bottom.

signature.name: Signature
signature.description: Notch, accent, motion. One or two per screen.
signature.where: Today progress, project health, journey, executive hero, insights, context switcher, schedule bar, focus timer. Large type only here.

specialized.name: Specialized visualization
specialized.description: Exists only where a specific screen design draws it.
specialized.where: Rings and charts. Never a default; colour and size follow that screen.

rulesPage.title: Rules
rulesPage.intro: The approved, reusable patterns of the final P00 system, each traced to a final board. The superseded S-boards are history only, and nothing here is extrapolated from a single screen: a pattern that exists only on some screens is marked screen-specific.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: Every component belongs to one tier. Signature, Product and Utility are the three card levels of P00CardsTabs; specialized visualizations exist only where a final board draws them.

utility.where: Filters, form groups, settings groups, KPI tiles and empty-state containers. 16–20px radius, subtle or white, no decoration. Never notched.

product.summary: Soft rounded rectangle, no notch, may be scope-tinted.
product.where: The standard surface for moderate content: 28px radius, optional scope tint. Sheets, drawers and floating panels are product surfaces too (32px, no notch).

signature.summary: One important object: a sculpted corner holding one circular primary action, or left empty.
signature.where: Today hero, Now card, Insight, Timeline, Focus timer, Balance summary, Weekly Story and the other cards of “Where in Personal”. At most 3 per desktop viewport, 1–2 on mobile, only one volt.

specialized.summary: Exists only where a final board draws it.
specialized.where: The Today ring (P01), the Habit RingCard (P12) and the frozen DataViz language. Never a default; colour and size follow that board.

classification.title: Component classification
classification.description: Every component built so far, with its tier. Rows marked retiring are still in the code but must not be used in new work.

componentNotes.signatureCard: Sculpted top corner (top-left in RTL), 32px radius. Presets: desktop 64×64 / f28 with a 54px button, mobile 56×56 / f24 with 46px, Focus 72×72 / f30 with 56px. One circular primary action or an empty notch.
componentNotes.productCard: 28px radius, no notch, optional scope tint. The standard surface.
componentNotes.utilityCard: 20px radius, subtle or white, 18px padding, no shadow. Fields are 48px rows with a 16px radius.
componentNotes.metricTile: KPI family: one shared 20px geometry, never a notch per tile. Danger tiles name their state.
componentNotes.folderTabs: Sections of ONE object. Variants top and bottom-even; on mobile the top tabs become pills above the panel.
componentNotes.progressRing: Only the Today ring (P01 Overview) and the Habit RingCard (P12).
componentNotes.ringCard: Habit detail only (P12): ring with History · Details bottom tabs.
componentNotes.progress: Default progress: number + linear bar. Also compact inline (size sm).
componentNotes.segmentedProgress: Default progress for proportional parts or n-of-m steps.
componentNotes.tabs: Compact pills for local filters (outlined on desktop, soft mint on mobile); filled pills for a mode needing emphasis (Focus / Break).
componentNotes.tooltip: White island (the card surface in dark) with a hairline ring and 16px radius. Never black.
componentNotes.sheet: End drawer (420px) and detail drawer (520px), centred sheet and bottom sheet; every one is a bottom sheet on mobile. 32px radius, no notch.
componentNotes.floatingPanel: Non-modal panel at the bottom inline-end for Quick note and Voice; a bottom sheet on mobile.
componentNotes.dialog: Modal confirmation, such as “Delete task?” (P06). Flows use the P18 containers instead.
componentNotes.toast: White surface, mint icon and Undo (P99). Never notched.
componentNotes.statusChip: Priority, due, status and scope chips. Always labelled, never colour alone.
componentNotes.switcher: Top-bar shell island (P00PersonalIA). Reviewed with the shell in 1C.
componentNotes.schedule: Top-bar shell island; its now-dot is volt. Reviewed with the shell in 1C.
componentNotes.mobileNav: Today · Tasks · + · Calendar · More (PM01). Global destinations are navigation, never tabs.
componentNotes.rail: Shell navigation: three groups + Settings. Flat, no notch.
componentNotes.notchedCard: Compatibility wrapper around SignatureCard; use SignatureCard.
componentNotes.assistant: AI is out of scope: the floating Assistant is removed from every P board.

patterns.title: Pattern audit
patterns.description: Where each pattern is allowed, where it is not, and whether it is universal or screen-specific.

progress.title: Progress
progress.allowed: A number with a linear bar (72%, 6/9, 37M / 60M) in any card, row or tile; segmented bars for proportional parts or n-of-m steps; compact inline bars with a count.
progress.notAllowed: A ring, gauge or arc as the default way to show progress, and progress styles no final board defines.

rings.title: Rings
rings.allowed: Only the Today progress ring on Overview (P01) and the Habit RingCard with History · Details bottom tabs (P12).
rings.notAllowed: Any other ring (the S11 goal ring is removed), or a ring in place of a linear bar.

gauges.title: Gauges
gauges.allowed: None. No final board draws a gauge.

dataViz.title: Data visualization
dataViz.allowed: Only the frozen DataViz language, each where its screen uses it: Goal Milestone Path (P11), Habit Field and Streak Ribbon (P12), Budget River and Budget Flow on separate Finance tabs (P13), Mood Terrain (P14), Focus Clock, Context Ribbon and Layered Area (P15), Weekly Story and Carry-over Flow (P16, P10). RTL follows the DataViz rules.
dataViz.notAllowed: River and Flow together, Terrain outside Journal, Layered Area outside Insights, one generic chart reused across screens, new chart colours, and CSS-flipping a chart.

cardGeometry.title: Card geometry
cardGeometry.allowed: Three levels. Signature: 32px radius with a sculpted corner. Product: 28px, no notch, optional scope tint. Utility: 16–20px, subtle or white, no decoration. A related family (KPI tiles, metric groups, people, rows) shares one clean geometry. One important object may be signature; repeated or dense content is product or utility.
cardGeometry.notAllowed: Other radii, a notch on each item of a family, decoration on utility cards, and floods of scope colour.

notches.title: Notches
notches.allowed: Signature cards only, with the desktop (64×64, 28px fillets, 54px button), mobile (56×56, 24px, 46px) and Focus (72×72, 30px, 56px) presets. Exactly one circular action, always the card’s primary (Start focus, Open, Expand, Add), or an empty notch — encouraged on one card per view (Insight, Weekly Story, Goal summary). At most 3 signature cards per desktop viewport, 1–2 on mobile, only one volt. The corner mirrors to top-left in RTL; in dark it reads by surface contrast, with no outline.
notches.notAllowed: Task rows, list and table rows, board cards, inputs and form sections, filter panels, settings groups, KPI tiles, chart tiles in a grid, toasts and sheets. A menu of icons in the notch, an icon stuffed into every cut-out, and the retired compact and double presets.

tabs.title: Tab families
tabs.allowed: Pick by meaning. View mode → Segmented (Day/Week/Month, List/Board, Shamsi/Gregorian). Small local filter → compact pills. Mode needing emphasis → filled pills (Focus / Short break / Long break). Sections of one object → folder tabs. 2–3 views of a compact object → bottom tabs (RingCard). Wizards → stepper.
tabs.notAllowed: Choosing a family by taste, tabs for global destinations (they are navigation: rail and bottom nav), and underline tabs.

folderTabs.title: Folder tabs
folderTabs.allowed: Sections of one object: Task detail, Goal detail, Habit detail (bottom tabs), Finance, Insights, Journal and the spec cards of every P-board. Active tab 56px tall with a 24px top radius and 20px concave fillets; inactive tabs 44px outlined capsules; optional muted count. Fillets mirror in RTL; on mobile the tabs become pills above the panel.
folderTabs.notAllowed: Global navigation, Day/Week/Month, List/Board, binary toggles, dense filter sets, wizard steps, and coloured count badges.

volt.title: Volt
volt.allowed: Live or now only: the Now card, a running timer, the now-dot and Start focus (it begins a live session). One volt area per viewport. Text on volt uses on-accent.
volt.notAllowed: Success or completion (Complete is mint), a paused timer (it turns soft mint), decoration, and a second volt area in the viewport.

surfaces.title: Surfaces & dark
surfaces.allowed: Ink only for text and line icons. Light deep cards use #0E6B57. Dark: graphite canvas #121412, surfaces step lighter (#1C1F1C), deep cards #173A31, volt #B4F58C. Tooltips and toasts are surface islands.
surfaces.notAllowed: Black surfaces of any kind (cards, tooltips, toasts, pills), and outlines to separate a notch in dark.

status.title: Status & accessibility
status.allowed: Colour always paired with a label, icon or shape: priority, due, status and scope chips carry text; danger tiles and blocked tasks name their state. Real buttons and links, ARIA states, a visible focus ring, 48px hit areas and a reduced-motion fallback.
status.notAllowed: Colour as the only signal, volt as a status, and scope colours for categories that are not scopes.

scopeColours.title: Scope colours
scopeColours.allowed: Personal green, Projects blue, Teams indigo, Companies purple, each as soft, deep and dot: soft for selected backgrounds and tints, deep for primary actions and text on soft (Personal #0E6B57), dot for markers, legends and chart series. The active scope sets the primary.
scopeColours.notAllowed: Floods of scope colour, a scope colour meaning a non-scope category, and hues outside the token set.

containers.title: Sheets & panels
containers.allowed: Desktop: drawer (420px) for multi-field create and edit, detail drawer (520px) for Task detail, popover for one-decision flows (Mood, Reschedule), centred sheet for Add expense and Quick Add, floating panel for Quick note and Voice. Mobile: all are bottom sheets. Edit opens the same component pre-filled; every save closes it, shows a toast with Undo and highlights the item.
containers.notAllowed: Full pages for these flows (only Task create keeps a page), and a notch on the sheet or panel itself (the Task detail drawer’s head card is the one signature, P06).

resolved.title: Resolved decisions
resolved.description: Points the package left open or contradictory, now decided. They are rules.

notchSize.title: Notch size
notchSize.decision: Desktop notch 64×64 with 28px fillets and a 54px button, as P00 draws it.

retiredPresets.title: Old notch presets
retiredPresets.decision: The compact (60×60) and double (112×60) presets of the S-boards are retired.

dataVizColours.title: Chart colours
dataVizColours.decision: Finance and every other chart keep the frozen DataViz colours.

screenshotWins.title: Text versus screenshot
screenshotWins.decision: When P00 text and a final P-board screenshot disagree, the final screenshot wins.

compactPills.title: Compact pills
compactPills.decision: Outlined on desktop, soft mint on mobile.

thursday.title: Thursday
thursday.decision: A half working day, labelled «نیمه‌تعطیل» in Persian. Friday is the weekend.

persianDefault.title: Default language
persianDefault.decision: Persian (RTL, Jalali, Toman) is the default; English is a Settings option.

superseded.title: Superseded boards
superseded.description: Kept for history only. They are not evidence for any rule on this page.

items.mobileFa: Superseded for Personal; FaRules stays a foundation.
items.dataViz: Superseded by the v2 and added visualizations.
items.laterPhases: Projects, Teams and Companies phases; not used for Personal.
